_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Cost Contract Continuous Maintenance and Emergent Work Report
summary: This report is used by the government to verify that contract costs are documented and that the program is on schedule relative to task milestones and completion dates.
use_relationship:
This report will be used to by the government to verify that contract costs are documented and that the program is on schedule relating to the task milestones and/or completion dates.
This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be presented in a format similar to that of Figures 1-5.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain all information specified in Figures 1-5 and the following:

children.title: Incurred cost to the sub contract line item number (SubCLIN funding source) level, up to and including the current through 50% of the availability time elapsed.
Variance analyses shall be included at the 25% of availability time elapsed.
Cost of the work item, identified and groups to show the applicable SubCLIN (funding source) and shall be identified at each 25% time elapsed.
Negotiated values for growth to the work item level.
Identification of Master Ship Repair (MSR) teaming partners as subcontractors, for those contracts with teaming agreements.
children.content: Team member reports shall include total cost by labor and material.

children.title: Prime contractor costs shall include prorated costs based on the budget at completion (BAC) at 50% time elapsed.
Variance analysis information for each work item with a variance of +/- 10% and variances in excess of $10,000, whichever is higher.
children.content: In addition, variance analysis information shall include variances in excess of $100,000.

children.title: SubCLIN/level cost/schedule status report (C/SSR) monthly and Work Item Level C/SSR quarterly.
children.content: Report shall also include C/SSR graphical analysis information along with the definition of all terms used and a narrative analysis of overall contract performance.

children.title: Dollars vs time elapsed at the SubCLIN level for budgeted cost of work scheduled (BCWS), budgeted cost of work performed (BCWP), actual cost of work performed (ACWP) and estimate at completion (EAC).
Man hours vs. time elapsed at the SubCLIN level for budgeted quantity of work scheduled (BQWS), budgeted quantity of work performed (BQWP), actual quantity of work performed (AQWP) and EAC.
